query:
# Spouse triples whose value is an instance of a class that the conflicts-with
# constraint on P26 forbids for the subject (classes as listed in
# p26-constraint-qualifiers, 2026-11-14), and whose reverse triple is absent.
# Direct P31 only; no subclass closure. A sample, not a count.
PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>
PREFIX p: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/>
PREFIX ps: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/statement/>
PREFIX pq: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/qualifier/>
PREFIX wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#>
PREFIX bd: <http://www.bigdata.com/rdf#>

SELECT ?a ?aLabel ?b ?bLabel ?class ?classLabel WHERE {
  VALUES ?class { wd:Q101352 wd:Q11879590 wd:Q12308941 wd:Q15623926
                  wd:Q202444 wd:Q3409032 wd:Q4167410 wd:Q577 }
  ?a wdt:P26 ?b .
  ?b wdt:P31 ?class .
  FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?b wdt:P26 ?a }
  SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en" }
}
LIMIT 200
